correctness.rationale: Independently differentiated the exact displayed P and Q with rational symbolic algebra: P(x,1)=0, Q(x,1)=(x-1)(x-2)(2x-3). The Jacobian at (3/2,1) is [[0,-19/16],[-1/2,13/6]], determinant -19/32 and eigenvalues (26±sqrt(1018))/24 of opposite signs. Direct evaluation at the other two roots yields [[0,-1],[1,0]]. The polynomial on y=1 has exactly three roots; no off-line exhaustion or global phase portrait is inferred. The source-tree verification script was read; this independent calculation does not rely on its output.
